newsitem.title: USA: Fed proposes to further ease underwriting curbs.
newsitem.headline: Fed proposes to further ease underwriting curbs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Board on Wednesday issued a proposal that would ease restrictions governing the relationship between bank holding companies and their investment-banking affiliates.

The proposal would eliminate most of the so-called "firewalls" under Section 20 of the board's rules. The firewalls strictly separated the activity of the holding company from the investment-banking affiliates.
While eliminating most of the firewalls the proposal would incorporate remaining restrictions into a statement of operating standards.
